method: Painted --accent and --course-accent for all six palettes x two modes through an SVG raster onto a canvas, read pixels back, converted sRGB to OKLab, compared chroma. Cross-checked against getComputedStyle fillStyle parsing; both paths agreed.
bar: skill accepts 0-8 percent average and up to 55 percent worst cell (the seven shipped hues' measured range)
note: Method validated against the shipped +125 entry, whose recorded figures are 5.4 average and 32 worst (light/aubergine); the same measurement reproduces compatible magnitudes for a neighbouring rotation.
smallNegativeValues: plus/minus one percent on near-gamut cells is eight-bit quantisation noise in the pixel readback, not real chroma gain
